## Hobbies

::: {.hobby-stack}
::: {.hobby-card}
### Reading
I like reading because it gives me new ideas and makes it easier to think carefully about complex topics. I am steady rather than fast, and I usually prefer books that teach me something useful.
:::

::: {.hobby-card}
### Photography
Photography helps me notice composition, contrast, and detail. I am comfortable with casual shooting and editing, and I enjoy taking pictures that tell a simple story.
:::

::: {.hobby-card}
### Walking and Hiking
I enjoy walking and hiking because they clear my head and give me time to think. I am in decent shape for local trails and like exploring places that feel quiet and natural.
:::
